text:
Served items: 2 poached/fried eggs (~70 kcal each = 140), 1 slice white toast (~75), a latte-type coffee with milk (~80), a butter portion (~35, 5 g), water.

Served total: ~330 kcal.

After the meal, the butter portion is still on the tray, with the foil lid beside it, so it looks uneaten (its contents look yellow, like butter). Eggs and toast are gone, with only small egg residue on the plate. The coffee is finished, with a slight residue.

Leftover: butter ~35, plus a little egg residue ~10, which comes to ~45.

Eaten: 330 − 45 = 285 kcal.

Macros eaten: eggs ~12 g protein, 10 g fat, 1 g carbs; toast 2.5 g protein, 14 g carbs, 1 g fat; latte 4 g protein, 6 g carbs, 4 g fat. Totals: protein ~18 g, carbs ~21 g, fat ~15 g. That gives 72 + 84 + 135 = 291 kcal, which is consistent.
